summary: Iter 19 — PRODUCTION (https://auremcto.com) end-to-end UI/UX test against qa-prod@aurem.dev. SIGNIFICANT IMPROVEMENT vs iter 18: all four iter-18 P0/P1 'pending prod redeploy' items are now LIVE on prod — (a) Composer placeholder = 'Ask ORA to build, fix, or scan...' ✓, (b) Theme toggle 3-state cycle dark→light→auto→dark ✓, (c) Mode pills Swift/Pro/Maxx persist to localStorage ✓, (d) Avatar dropdown (Edit Profile / Settings / Token Recharge / Logout) renders correctly with proper user identity ✓, (e) LOOP OFF/ON pill toggles and persists. NEW prod build (commit hash unknown — /api/aurem-dev/health is 404; correct path is /api/health). REMAINING / NEW PROD BUGS: P0-1 Topbar auto-hide on scroll is NOT working — topbar height stayed 87px through scroll-down and scroll-up cycles (this is the user's main 'screen fluctuation / black ghost header gap' complaint and is NOT yet on prod). P0-2 Prompt-mode send click appears to fire but no user bubble nor ORA reply rendered in the chat — composer still showed the unsent text and only the initial ORA greeting bubble remained (regression vs iter 18 where send worked). P1-1 NewUserWizard 'Connect your GitHub repo' modal STILL auto-opens on every /dashboard load for the 0-project test user (iter-18 P0 fix not deployed). P1-2 Graph/Preview tab buttons fire (clicks register) but URL does not change and the side drawer effect was not visually verifiable — no regression but no confirmation of GraphPanel/PreviewPanel drawer opening. P2-1 The 'X console errors' badge inside ChatPanel shows '1 console error' on first load — root cause is a 404 on /api/aurem-dev/health that some startup probe is hitting (badge correctly reflects this). No tool_call XML / LOOP_PHASE / [Working on project:] leaks were observed in the rendered bubble (sanitizer works). Mobile 390×844 has no horizontal overflow. Console errors filtered for app-origin: only 1 (the /aurem-dev/health 404). Network 4xx/5xx: only 1 (same /aurem-dev/health 404). Stream-health pill 30s/90s state, Loop ship→GitHub commit, and Ship modal could NOT be tested because the test user has zero connected projects (active_project=null) which is the documented constraint for qa-prod.

minor.issue: Returns 404 on prod (correct path is /api/health). Some frontend startup probe still calls /aurem-dev/health and produces a visible '1 console error' badge in the chat UI on every page load. Either remove the probe call or add a /aurem-dev/health alias that proxies to /api/health.

ui_bugs.issue: P0: Topbar does NOT auto-collapse on scroll-down. Measured getBoundingClientRect().height before/after scrollBy(0,800) and scrollBy(0,-800) → 87px / 87px / 87px (no change). The user explicitly called out 'screen fluctuation' and 'black ghost header gap' — this fix is NOT deployed to prod yet. Need to verify maxHeight collapse logic is in the prod bundle.

P0: Clicking the orange send button after filling 'reply with exactly: hello world' did NOT produce a user-side bubble nor an ORA reply within 8 seconds. The composer textarea still contained the unsent text and the rendered bubble count remained at 1 (the initial greeting). This is a REGRESSION vs iter 18 where prompt send worked. Possible causes: (a) send onClick depends on a project_id and silently no-ops when active_project is null, (b) the loop-toggle state toggled to ON during the toggle test and the send is now waiting on a plan that never appears, (c) wizard overlay is intercepting pointer events on the composer area.

P1: 'Connect your GitHub repo' modal still auto-opens on every /dashboard mount for the 0-project user. Backdrop is full-viewport and covers the topbar (visible in screenshot 1). iter-18 P0 fix (localStorage 'aurem_wizard_dismissed' guard + carve-out for sidebar/topbar) is NOT yet deployed. After clicking Skip the dashboard becomes interactable, but the wizard returns on every reload.

P2: Clicking [data-testid='ds2-tab-graph'] and [data-testid='ds2-tab-preview'] fires without console error but the URL does not change and we could not visually confirm whether the GraphPanel drawer or PreviewPanel iframe actually opened. Visual verification blocked because the test user has no connected repo. Add a clear empty-state ('No repo connected — connect to see graph') so the click feels responsive.

integration_issues.issue: P0: Send click fires but neither outgoing /chat/send request nor incoming SSE chunks produced a visible bubble. Need network-tab inspection to confirm whether the request actually hit /api/aurem-dev/chat/send.
Front-end probe hits a non-existent endpoint on prod and the visible 'console error' badge in the UI scares users.

issues: Wizard backdrop dims topbar + sidebar + Ask Advisor — full-viewport overlay (see screenshot 01_login.png after auto-login). Should carve out the chrome so user feels less trapped.
The 'LOOP OFF' / 'LOOP ON' pill and the red '1 console error — send to ORA' badge sit very close to the send button; some users may misclick. Add 6-8px more breathing room.

Likely needs a fallback for users with active_project=null (auto-create a sandbox project or show 'Connect a repo first' inline). critical_code_review_comments: ChatPanel.jsx send handler — must NOT silently no-op when active_project is null. Either route to a sandbox project, show an inline 'Connect a repo to chat with your codebase' empty-state in the composer, or render a toast. Today the user clicks and nothing happens — looks completely broken.

TopBar.jsx scroll-collapse — verify the IntersectionObserver / scroll listener is bound to the actual chat scroll container (probably [data-testid='chat-scroll']) and not window. On prod the height never changes which suggests the listener is bound to the wrong element OR maxHeight transition isn't applied.

NewUserWizard.jsx — add `const [dismissed, setDismissed] = useState(()=>localStorage.getItem('aurem_wizard_dismissed')==='1');` and gate the modal on `!dismissed && projects.length===0`. Also reduce backdrop opacity over .ds2-sidebar and [data-testid='ds2-topbar'] OR set pointer-events:none on those regions of the backdrop.

Routes — `/api/aurem-dev/health` should either be added as a thin alias to `/api/health` or removed from the front-end startup probe. The user-visible '1 console error' badge that appears on every dashboard load is purely from this 404 and erodes trust.

rca_of_top_bugs: 1) Topbar auto-hide: scroll listener likely bound to window but the actual scroll container is [data-testid='chat-scroll'] — confirm by inspecting useEffect inside TopBar.jsx or wherever the scroll-state hook lives. 2) Prompt-mode send no-op: send handler in ChatPanel.jsx likely early-returns when no active_project — needs either a sandbox fallback or a user-facing 'Connect a repo first' message instead of silent failure. 3) Wizard backdrop: full-viewport <div className='wizard-backdrop'> with pointer-events:auto blocks topbar + sidebar interactions until Skip is clicked, AND the dismissal is not persisted across reloads.
